description: count_distinct is the exact spelling, not countDistinct.

cypher.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS n

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS n $$) AS (n agtype)

iso_gql.statement: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS n

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.id AS id))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.id AS id))
